create_NashCMAES: create a NashCMAES instance to search for a Restricted Nash Equilibrium using CMA-ES optimization
run_NashCMAES_step: run the NashCMAES step method to evolve policy mixtures toward lower exploitability
test_compute_exploitability: test the compute_exploitability method to measure how well a policy mixture resists exploitation
review_get_exploitabilities: review the get_exploitabilities method to evaluate exploitability across multiple policy mixtures
summarize_compute_average_regret: summarize the compute_average_regret method that returns the current exploitability as average regret
